extraction.text:
Vishal Gaikwad Senior Business Analyst

vg1809052@gmail.com | 8600617853 | linkedin.com/in/vishal-gaikwad-09a12a13a | Mumbai/Pune/Bangalore

Indian

10/07/1992 Immediate Joiner

Senior Business Analyst with 7+ years of experience delivering enterprise-scale digital transformation initiatives across Banking, Payments, FinTech, Lending, API Platforms, and Regulatory Compliance. Successfully led the implementation of India's Retail & Wholesale CBDC rollout across 18+ banks, RBI Samadhan, HDFC Bank Developer Portal, Loan Origination System (LOS), and Loan Management System (LMS). Proven track record of translating complex business requirements into BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, AS-IS/TO-BE process models, and BPMN workflows, enabling successful solution delivery. Drove business process optimization, REST API integrations, UAT management, release planning, and Agile delivery, resulting in improved operational efficiency, enhanced customer experience, and reduced implementation risks. Adept at collaborating with regulators, business stakeholders, architects, developers, QA, and cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and regulatory-compliant solutions while accelerating digital transformation initiatives.

WORK EXPERIANCE

National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) Sr. Business Analyst

03/2025 – 07/2026 | Mumbai

Project Name- Retail CBDC, Wholesale CBDC, RBI Samadhan. Gathered and documented business requirements into BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows for Corporate Banking and Payment solutions. Analyzed and optimized Cash Management processes, including SWIFT payments, domestic payments, collections, reconciliation, settlement, liquidity, and transaction lifecycle management. Defined business rules, workflow logic, REST API integration requirements, and exception handling for banking and payment platforms. Collaborated with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, developers, QA teams, and banking partners to deliver enterprise payment solutions. Conducted requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews, gap analysis, impact analysis, and AS-IS/TO-BE process modeling. Managed UAT, prepared test scenarios, validated payment workflows, and coordinated defect resolution for successful production releases. Performed Root Cause Analysis (RCA), production support, and incident management to ensure system stability and business continuity. Supported Agile/Scrum delivery by refining user stories, prioritizing backlogs, and defining acceptance criteria. Contributed to Corporate Banking and Cash Management transformation, supporting SWIFT, STP, payment modernization, reconciliation, settlement, and digital banking initiatives.

1 / 2

UST: Digital Transformation Solutions Company Business Analyst

01/2024 – 07/2024 | Bangalore

Project Name- HDFC Developer Portal Contributed to the implementation of Corporate Banking solutions, enabling SWIFT payment processing, cross-border payments, and secure financial messaging. Designed end-to-end SWIFT payment workflows covering payment initiation, MT/MX message processing, validation, sanctions screening, reconciliation, and settlement. Prepared BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Process Flows, and Functional Specifications, ensuring clear requirements and timely delivery. Streamlined corporate client onboarding, SWIFT connectivity, beneficiary management, and payment authorization workflows to improve operational efficiency. Supported integration with SWIFT Network, Core Banking Systems, REST APIs, ISO 20022, OAuth 2.0, API Security, and JWT authentication. Performed AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, collaborated with business and technology teams, and supported UAT, SIT, production releases, and defect management in an Agile (Scrum) environment. Worked with Compliance, Risk, AML, and Sanctions Screening teams to ensure regulatory compliance and improve Straight-Through Processing (STP) and payment turnaround time (TAT).

Rego Digital Solutions Business Analyst

02/2021 – 12/2023 | Bangalore

Project Name- GLOW (Loan Sourcing) and Trucell (Collections) applications Produced comprehensive Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), User Stories, Functional Specifications, and Acceptance Criteria, enabling accurate solution design and successful implementation of corporate banking and payment solutions. Led business analysis for Corporate Banking, SWIFT Payments, and Cross-Border Payment initiatives, translating business requirements into detailed functional specifications and process flows. Performed requirements elicitation, stakeholder workshops, AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, process mapping, and gap analysis to optimize corporate payment processing, trade finance, and cash management workflows. Collaborated with business stakeholders, operations, compliance, QA, and development teams to deliver enhancements across SWIFT MT/MX messaging, cross-border payments, RTGS, NEFT, and corporate payment platforms using Agile methodologies. Defined and validated business rules for SWIFT payment lifecycle, including payment initiation, message validation, authorization, routing, settlement, reconciliation, exception handling, and repair processes.

Managed User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, production releases, and Go-Live support, ensuring high-quality deployments with minimal business disruption. Improved operational efficiency by optimizing payment processing, reconciliation, exception management, and straight-through processing (STP), reducing turnaround time and improving transaction accuracy. Developed MIS reports, operational dashboards, and business insights to monitor payment volumes, transaction status, reconciliation, operational KPIs, and regulatory reporting. Successfully delivered end-to-end implementations for Corporate Banking Payment Systems, SWIFT Integration, Cash Management, and Cross-Border Payment Solutions, ensuring timely delivery and stakeholder satisfaction. Worked closely with compliance teams to ensure adherence to SWIFT standards (MT/MX), ISO 20022, AML, Sanctions Screening, FATF, RBI, and international payment regulations, maintaining regulatory compliance across payment operations. Supported continuous process improvement initiatives by identifying automation opportunities, reducing manual interventions, enhancing payment processing efficiency, and improving customer experience.

The Four Walls Properties Project Co-Ordinator/ Business Analyst

01/2016 – 11/2018 | Pune

Spearheaded end-to-end business analysis by translating Corporate Banking and SWIFT payment requirements into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows. Defined and optimized corporate payment workflows, including SWIFT MT/MX messaging, payment initiation, authorization, settlement, and reconciliation processes. Performed AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, gap assessments, and process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and reduce manual interventions. Collaborated with business stakeholders, operations, compliance, and technology teams to gather requirements and deliver banking solutions aligned with business objectives. Facilitated Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder workshops to ensure timely delivery of high-priority initiatives. Led UAT, defect management, release validation, and production support, ensuring high-quality deployments and seamless business operations. Ensured compliance with SWIFT standards, regulatory requirements, AML/KYC, and internal banking governance throughout the solution lifecycle. Created process models, workflow diagrams, and functional documentation using BPMN, Visio, and Draw.io to support solution design and stakeholder communication. Served as the key liaison between business and technology teams, ensuring accurate requirement translation and successful project delivery.

EDUCATION HISTORY

Dr.D.Y. Patil international University

02/2018 – 08/2020 | Pune

Master of Business Administration

Marketing

WORK EXPERIANCE
National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) Sr. Business Analyst
03/2025 – 07/2026 | Mumbai
Project Name- Retail CBDC, Wholesale CBDC, RBI Samadhan. Gathered and documented business requirements into BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows for Corporate Banking and Payment solutions. Analyzed and optimized Cash Management processes, including SWIFT payments, domestic payments, collections, reconciliation, settlement, liquidity, and transaction lifecycle management. Defined business rules, workflow logic, REST API integration requirements, and exception handling for banking and payment platforms. Collaborated with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, developers, QA teams, and banking partners to deliver enterprise payment solutions. Conducted requirement workshops, stakeholder interviews, gap analysis, impact analysis, and AS-IS/TO-BE process modeling. Managed UAT, prepared test scenarios, validated payment workflows, and coordinated defect resolution for successful production releases. Performed Root Cause Analysis (RCA), production support, and incident management to ensure system stability and business continuity. Supported Agile/Scrum delivery by refining user stories, prioritizing backlogs, and defining acceptance criteria. Contributed to Corporate Banking and Cash Management transformation, supporting SWIFT, STP, payment modernization, reconciliation, settlement, and digital banking initiatives.
UST: Digital Transformation Solutions Company Business Analyst
01/2024 – 07/2024 | Bangalore
Project Name- HDFC Developer Portal Contributed to the implementation of Corporate Banking solutions, enabling SWIFT payment processing, cross-border payments, and secure financial messaging. Designed end-to-end SWIFT payment workflows covering payment initiation, MT/MX message processing, validation, sanctions screening, reconciliation, and settlement. Prepared BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Process Flows, and Functional Specifications, ensuring clear requirements and timely delivery. Streamlined corporate client onboarding, SWIFT connectivity, beneficiary management, and payment authorization workflows to improve operational efficiency. Supported integration with SWIFT Network, Core Banking Systems, REST APIs, ISO 20022, OAuth 2.0, API Security, and JWT authentication. Performed AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, collaborated with business and technology teams, and supported UAT, SIT, production releases, and defect management in an Agile (Scrum) environment. Worked with Compliance, Risk, AML, and Sanctions Screening teams to ensure regulatory compliance and improve Straight-Through Processing (STP) and payment turnaround time (TAT).
Rego Digital Solutions Business Analyst
02/2021 – 12/2023 | Bangalore
Project Name- GLOW (Loan Sourcing) and Trucell (Collections) applications Produced comprehensive Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), User Stories, Functional Specifications, and Acceptance Criteria, enabling accurate solution design and successful implementation of corporate banking and payment solutions. Led business analysis for Corporate Banking, SWIFT Payments, and Cross-Border Payment initiatives, translating business requirements into detailed functional specifications and process flows. Performed requirements elicitation, stakeholder workshops, AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, process mapping, and gap analysis to optimize corporate payment processing, trade finance, and cash management workflows. Collaborated with business stakeholders, operations, compliance, QA, and development teams to deliver enhancements across SWIFT MT/MX messaging, cross-border payments, RTGS, NEFT, and corporate payment platforms using Agile methodologies. Defined and validated business rules for SWIFT payment lifecycle, including payment initiation, message validation, authorization, routing, settlement, reconciliation, exception handling, and repair processes.
Managed User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, production releases, and Go-Live support, ensuring high-quality deployments with minimal business disruption. Improved operational efficiency by optimizing payment processing, reconciliation, exception management, and straight-through processing (STP), reducing turnaround time and improving transaction accuracy. Developed MIS reports, operational dashboards, and business insights to monitor payment volumes, transaction status, reconciliation, operational KPIs, and regulatory reporting. Successfully delivered end-to-end implementations for Corporate Banking Payment Systems, SWIFT Integration, Cash Management, and Cross-Border Payment Solutions, ensuring timely delivery and stakeholder satisfaction. Worked closely with compliance teams to ensure adherence to SWIFT standards (MT/MX), ISO 20022, AML, Sanctions Screening, FATF, RBI, and international payment regulations, maintaining regulatory compliance across payment operations. Supported continuous process improvement initiatives by identifying automation opportunities, reducing manual interventions, enhancing payment processing efficiency, and improving customer experience.
The Four Walls Properties Project Co-Ordinator/ Business Analyst
01/2016 – 11/2018 | Pune
Spearheaded end-to-end business analysis by translating Corporate Banking and SWIFT payment requirements into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows. Defined and optimized corporate payment workflows, including SWIFT MT/MX messaging, payment initiation, authorization, settlement, and reconciliation processes. Performed AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, gap assessments, and process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and reduce manual interventions. Collaborated with business stakeholders, operations, compliance, and technology teams to gather requirements and deliver banking solutions aligned with business objectives. Facilitated Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and stakeholder workshops to ensure timely delivery of high-priority initiatives. Led UAT, defect management, release validation, and production support, ensuring high-quality deployments and seamless business operations. Ensured compliance with SWIFT standards, regulatory requirements, AML/KYC, and internal banking governance throughout the solution lifecycle. Created process models, workflow diagrams, and functional documentation using BPMN, Visio, and Draw.io to support solution design and stakeholder communication. Served as the key liaison between business and technology teams, ensuring accurate requirement translation and successful project delivery.
